name: runs
title: Runs
description: One row per run: one execution, with a stable unique id. The deployments registry is the host's (PEP 0010 §8).

fields.name: deployment
fields.description: the installed machine the run ran on: the 1-DOF rack, the UR5e cell

fields.name: started
fields.description: the run's start, ISO 8601 with its UTC offset; the absolute order of runs

fields.name: kind
fields.description: what the run did: waypoints, sine, chirp, staircase, gravity, tape

fields.name: devices
fields.description: the devices the run has rows for

fields.name: rate_hz
fields.description: the rate the run was logged at

fields.name: display_hz
fields.description: the rate written for display, by picking rows (never averaging)

fields.name: label
fields.description: a short name for the run

fields.name: basis
fields.description: what made the numbers: a CONTRACT §7 basis word
